type: fintech/DeFi product — transferable 3-colour system + isometric illustration

fonts.display: grotesk 500 ~96px/0.95 ls -0.03em, italic for 1 emphasised word ('Starts', 'Battle-Tested')

moves: sticky pill nav (dark rounded bar) with one filled blue CTA
hero: giant 2-line headline centered, 1-line sub, 2 buttons (blue + white)
blue 'card' section with corner + marks and rotating headline carousel (masked text swap) + isometric brick illustration in a white inset
stat tiles 4-up (blue/black/grey/white) with NUMBER SCRAMBLE animation on reveal
Battle-Tested Security: 2-col, left headline + grey sub + 2 buttons, right isometric 3D illustration
vertical blue line-pattern texture section for closing CTA
footer: solid blue, link columns, GIANT wordmark cut off at bottom edge
mobile: full-width blue card, full-width button with separate arrow cell, checklist rows in cards
rules_derived: 3 colours only, applied as whole-surface blocks
isometric line illustration of abstract product metaphor (bricks, stack) = consistent visual language without photos
number scramble on stats = cheap wow
italic single word in a sans headline = emphasis without colour
